# barndoor_dlp_detection_engine (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Data Protection (DLP) detection engine — a **Protection Profile** in the platform app — by `id` or by `name`. Use it to feed `barndoor_dlp_enforcement_policy.detection_engine_ids` with an engine that is not managed by this Terraform configuration, or as the lookup step before a `terraform import`.

Engine names are unique per organization **and** `provider_type`, so one UI Protection Profile can be several engines sharing a name; a by-`name` lookup that matches more than one engine fails and lists the candidates — set `provider_type` (or `id`) to disambiguate.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing detection engine ("Protection Profile" in the app) by
# name to reference it without managing it. Names are only unique per
# provider_type — set provider_type (or use id) when one profile spans
# several engines.
data "barndoor_dlp_detection_engine" "pii" {
  name          = "Corporate PII"
  provider_type = "presidio"
}

# The looked-up engine feeds enforcement policies.
resource "barndoor_dlp_enforcement_policy" "tokenize_pii" {
  name   = "Tokenize PII on MCP traffic"
  action = "POLICY_ACTION_TOKENIZE"

  mcp_targets = [
    { mcp_server_id = "*", direction = "BOTH" },
  ]

  detection_engine_ids = [data.barndoor_dlp_detection_engine.pii.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Detection engine UUID. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Display name of the detection engine (the Protection Profile name in the app). Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set. The comparison is exact after trimming surrounding whitespace.
- `provider_type` (String) Detection provider backing the engine (e.g. `presidio`, `google_dlp`). Optional narrowing for a by-`name` lookup — the same name may exist for several provider types; only meaningful together with `name`.

### Read-Only

- `capabilities` (Attributes) Capability flags of the engine's provider. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--capabilities))
- `config` (String) Provider-specific engine configuration as JSON.
- `created_at` (String) When the engine was created (RFC 3339).
- `created_by` (String) Subject that created the engine.
- `enabled_detection_types` (List of String) Detection type wire names the engine scans for.
- `org_id` (String) Organization the detection engine belongs to.
- `provider_class` (String) Capability class of the provider: `native`, `span_detection`, or `guardrail_intervention`.
- `provider_connection_name` (String) Name of the Data Protection provider connection the engine uses, if any.
- `runtime_stages` (List of String) Runtime stages the engine can evaluate.
- `supported_actions` (List of String) Enforcement policy actions the engine supports.
- `supported_detection_types` (List of String) Every detection type wire name the engine's provider can produce.
- `updated_at` (String) When the engine was last updated (RFC 3339).
- `updated_by` (String) Subject that last updated the engine.
